user.title: Create a sync group
user.description: This creates a new 'Main' switch entity. Optionally link an existing switch/light entity as an additional master - useful when it can be triggered directly by its own device/integration (a physical button, a scene, another automation) rather than only through Main. Triggering either Main or the linked master turns every member to match. Triggering a member never affects other members, but it updates Main (and the linked master, if set): they turn off once every member is off, and turn on if a member turns on - without touching the other members. Unavailable entities are always ignored.
